lessons.title: 1. Counting Operations
lessons.description: Estimate work by counting loop iterations. Implement `linear_sum(n)` that sums 1..n in O(n) with an explicit loop.

lessons.title: 2. Constant vs Linear Lookup
lessons.description: Compare list membership (O(n)) vs set membership (O(1) average). Implement `has_in_set(items, target)`.
learning_objectives: Use a set for average O(1) membership
lessons.solution_code:
def has_in_set(items, target):
    return target in set(items)

lessons.title: 3. Nested Loops Complexity (Concept Challenge)
lessons.description: Implement `count_pairs(n)` that counts pairs (i,j) with 0<=i<j<n — classic O(n^2) nested loops — and return the count.

lessons.title: 4. Early Exit Search (Practice)
lessons.description: Implement `first_index(items, pred)` returning the first index where pred is true, or -1 — best case O(1).
learning_objectives: Stop scanning once a match is found

tests.name: test_first_index

lessons.title: 5. Unit 1 Checkpoint: Complexity
learning_objectives: Prefer O(1) closed form when available
